cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: The Conspiracy Expands
cards.instruction: Use every denial, coincidence, and missing detail as proof that more people and higher stakes are involved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. You and your manager both say my train was cancelled. Who told you to match stories?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The signal failed. It's on the public departure board.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. They've recruited the board operators to stop me reaching the interview.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The same fault is delaying three counties.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Three counties to keep me unemployed. My replacement must already have government backing.

mechanism: A treats a rail employee as a subordinate witness and grants permission to expose an ever-higher supposed plot against A's interview.
confusable: Unlike merely complaining about delays, A reads regional corroboration as evidence of coordinated personal sabotage.
comparison: An urgent journey and public-service employee differ from household shopping and warranty distrust.
seedUse: Use manager agreement, departure board and three counties; make S01 direct B's supposed disclosure as the conspiracy rises.
